name: zipnerf
description: zipnerf is a benchmark dataset for evaluating compressed neural radiance fields (NeRF) and fast view synthesis approaches. It measures both reconstruction quality and compression efficiency across a variety of scenes, enabling comparison of methods on visual fidelity and storage/bitrate trade-offs. Common evaluations report image-similarity metrics alongside compression/bitrate statistics to judge practical usefulness for real-time or embedded rendering.
evaluation_method: Image similarity metrics (PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS) combined with bitrate/compression metrics
general_score_metric: PSNR (primary), with SSIM/LPIPS and bitrate as secondary metrics
typical_sota_score: PSNR ~25–35 dB; SSIM ~0.70–0.95; LPIPS ~0.05–0.25 (varies by scene)
reputation: A niche benchmark popular within NeRF/compressed-rendering research groups but not yet broadly adopted across general vision benchmarks.
